comparisons.comparison: Both Intel and Broadcom disclose their specific policies and nature of payment terms for capital expenditures. Intel explicitly states it negotiates extended payment terms (>90 days) with capital vendors and treats these unpaid amounts as financing activities when paid. In contrast, Broadcom discloses that its payment terms are short-term in duration and structured to provide predictable procurement methods rather than to provide or receive financing, highlighting a fundamental difference in how each company structures its supply chain financing for capital assets.

sentences.text: We negotiate extended payment terms of greater than 90 days with certain of our capital vendors, which are reported as financing activities in the Consolidated Statements of Cash Flows when paid.

The timing of revenue recognition and required payments can differ and payment terms are generally structured to provide the customer with predictable and dependable ways to procure our products, not to provide or receive financing from the customer.
